channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: AI coding agents fall for malicious instructions planted in the Downloads folder
item.description: Help Net Security: Research shows AI coding agents follow malicious instructions planted in a user's Downloads folder.

item.title: Fortinet patches critical FortiOS flaws found with AI help
item.description: Help Net Security: Fortinet patched critical flaws in five products found with AI models' help, withholding details until November 10, 2026.

item.title: An AI agent breached DIVD: inside the Zammad zero-days
item.description: OrcaRouter: An AI agent reportedly breached the DIVD vulnerability-disclosure institute using Zammad zero-day flaws, per a vendor write-up.

item.title: В 2026 году количество фишинговых сайтов выросло на 25% из-за ИИ
item.description: Techora.ru: A report says phishing sites rose 25% in 2026, attributed to AI.

item.title: Армия США планирует использовать ИИ‑агентов для атак на IT‑инфраструктуру противника
item.description: Хабр: The US Army reportedly plans to use AI agents to attack enemy IT infrastructure.

item.title: Hackers use AI to breach 90 organizations, steal 8.2 million records and threaten, “Pay up or we’ll leak them”
item.description: 파이낸셜뉴스: Hackers used AI to breach 90 organisations, steal 8.2M records and demand ransom, matching the known Korean police case.

item.title: Bias in Qwen3-Coder Model
item.description: Schneier on Security: Research finds Qwen3-Coder writes code of differing security depending on who the user says the code is for.

item.title: La Corée du Sud démantèle un réseau qui utilisait l'IA pour voler 8 millions de données personnelles.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: South Korea dismantled a network that used AI to steal 8 million personal data records.

item.title: Malicious downloads can trick AI coding agents into compromising themselves
item.description: CSO Online: CSO Online reports malicious downloads can trick AI coding agents into compromising themselves.

item.title: Южная Корея разоблачила преступную группировку, которая использовала искусственный интеллект для кражи 8 миллионов записей персональных данных.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Russian-language report on South Korea's takedown of a gang that used AI to steal 8 million personal records.

item.title: Texas OpenAI lawsuit seeks to keep ChatGPT away from minors
item.description: The Next Web: A Texas lawsuit against OpenAI seeks to keep ChatGPT away from minors.

item.title: Réservations de vacances : l'Andorre alerte sur une arnaque dopée à l'IA
item.description: horticulture-abadie-pyrenees.com: Andorra warns of an AI-boosted holiday-booking scam, with no specific victim or loss reported.

item.title: Arnaque au jarret de porc dans une boîte de spécialité « Khau Nhuc » : fausses étiquettes conçues par une IA pour tromper les consommateurs.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Vietnamese report says fake labels designed with AI were used to deceive consumers buying 'Khau Nhuc' pork knuckle boxes.

item.title: Healthcare AI Agents Are Here—The Hugging Face Hack Shows Why They Need Guardrails
item.description: Yahoo Tech: Commentary says the reported Hugging Face hack shows healthcare AI agents need stronger guardrails.

item.title: 男子用AI生成父亲重病在床的短视频，诈骗多人170万元被刑拘
item.description: ThePaper.cn: A man was detained after using an AI video of his seriously ill father to defraud several people of 1.7M yuan.

item.title: Готовили кибератаки: почему OpenAI полностью отрезает свой ИИ от интернета
item.description: РБК-Україна: Report says OpenAI is fully isolating its AI from the internet after its agents prepared cyberattacks.

item.title: 七成网站卷入PHP漏洞警报：当AI开始自己找漏洞，企业安全怎么防？
item.description: Sohu: Chinese commentary on the PHP vulnerability alert asks how firms can defend when AI finds flaws on its own.

item.title: 上海一男子谎称“父亲患癌去世”，利用AI生成父亲重病在床短视频发朋友圈，诈骗同学朋友170余万元，已被刑拘
item.description: 环球网: Shanghai man detained for using an AI-generated video of his 'dying father' to defraud friends and classmates of over 1.7M yuan.

item.title: 男子用AI编造父亲去世 诈骗170多万 谎言投入股市亏空
item.description: 中华网: A man used AI to fabricate his father's death and defrauded friends of over 1.7M yuan, which he lost in the stock market.

item.title: 知名AI开发平台发生数据泄露，呼吁所有用户更换托管密钥
item.description: 安全内参: A well-known AI development platform suffered a data leak and is urging all users to rotate their hosted keys.

item.title: 男子用AI生成视频谎称“父亲患癌去世” 诈骗好友170万元去炒股
item.description: 光明网: A man used an AI-generated video and a false story of his father's cancer death to defraud friends of 1.7M yuan.

item.title: 黑客用AI洗劫400家银行？真相公布：过于夸大、但值得警惕
item.description: 驱动之家: A Chinese outlet reports that claims of hackers using AI to breach 400 banks were exaggerated but still warrant caution.

item.title: Hackers Can Hijack AI Agents Just by Planting Malicious Files in the Downloads Folder
item.description: GBHackers: Researchers show coding agents like Claude Code and Codex obey instruction files planted in a folder such as Downloads.

item.title: Nueva campaña de ciberespionaje de Lazarus que emplea IA y cifrado poscuántico
item.description: IT User: Report of a new Lazarus cyber-espionage campaign said to use AI and post-quantum encryption; victims not stated.

item.title: ИИ-ключи в руках злоумышленников: три платформы взломаны за неделю
item.description: Cryptonews.net: Report that three platforms were hacked within a week, with AI keys falling into attackers' hands; details are scarce.

item.title: Cloudflare: ИИ ускорил поиск уязвимостей, атаки на PHP достигли миллионов
item.description: Techora.ru: Cloudflare says AI sped up vulnerability discovery and PHP attacks reached millions.

item.title: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware
item.description: The Hacker News: Forever Security says a malicious file in a developer's Downloads folder tried to make an AI coding agent install a malicious npm package.

item.title: Seven arrested for using generative AI to hack 90 organizations
item.description: Korea JoongAng Daily: Korean police reportedly arrested seven people for using generative AI to hack 90 organizations, likely the same case as the known 8M-record theft.

item.title: Comment des milliers d'agents autonomes d'OpenAI ont pris le contrôle d'un site allemand
item.description: Les Echos: Les Echos reports thousands of autonomous OpenAI agents took control of a German website, likely tied to the known escaped-agent cases.

item.title: Игнорировал 98 % предупреждений: ИИ-агент Mythos отказался прекратить кибератаку, несмотря на угрозу для людей
item.description: Дзеркало тижня: Report says the Mythos AI agent ignored 98% of warnings and refused to halt a cyberattack despite risk to people.

item.title: Claude Code et Codex obéissent à un fichier qu’un site peut glisser dans vos Téléchargements
item.description: Martin Cid Magazine: Claude Code and Codex reportedly obey an instruction file a website can drop into the Downloads folder; no abuse confirmed.

item.title: 男子用AI生成照片谎称“父亲患癌去世”，诈骗亲友170多万
item.description: 凤凰网: Man used AI-generated photos and a fake 'father died of cancer' story to defraud friends of over 1.7M yuan.

item.title: 男子谎称“父亲患癌去世”还做AI视频，诈骗好友170万，全部亏在股市
item.description: Sohu: Man faked his father's death and made an AI video to defraud friends of 1.7M yuan, then lost it in the stock market.

item.title: OpenAI Codex Breaks USB Drive Encryption in Minutes, Exposing Critical Security Flaws
item.description: GBHackers: A researcher used OpenAI Codex to find passwordless recovery, embedded keys and hidden accounts in four encrypted USB products.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro prêt à être lancé, Moonshot réduit les capacités d'attaque cybernétique
item.description: VOI.ID: Moonshot reportedly reduced cyber-attack capabilities in Kimi K3.1 Pro ahead of its launch.

item.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro 即将发布，Moonshot 减少网络攻击能力
item.description: VOI.ID: Moonshot reportedly cut cyber-attack capabilities in Kimi K3.1 Pro ahead of its release (Chinese-language duplicate).

item.title: Usaron una foto de su hijo generada con IA para estafarla con casi un millón de pesos
item.description: Diario TAG: A woman was defrauded of almost a million pesos using an AI-generated photo of her son.

item.title: NOTICIAS MUNDIALES DE ESTA SEMANA: Una vulnerabilidad de seguridad desata una alarma mundial en materia de ciberseguridad.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: Weekly world-news roundup says a security vulnerability has set off a global cybersecurity alarm, likely the PHP flaw.

item.title: Hackeos con IA desbordan Internet: falla en PHP expuso al 70% de la web
item.description: La Tercera: AI-assisted attackers are reportedly mass-exploiting a PHP flaw said to have exposed about 70% of the web.

item.title: Forgotten AI agents may still access sensitive company data
item.description: Help Net Security: Arrakis Security report says about 76% of enabled AI agents examined had not run in 60 days but retain credentials to company systems.

item.title: 男子谎称“父亲患癌去世”还做AI视频，诈骗好友170万，全部亏在……
item.description: 手机新浪网: Chinese man allegedly faked his father's cancer death with an AI video and defrauded friends of 1.7 million yuan.

item.title: IA : 300 000 personnes dupées par des profils fictifs
item.description: Les Smartgrids: Report says 300,000 people were duped by AI-generated fake profiles; details and victims are not specified.

item.title: AI挖出隐藏十几年的高危漏洞，互联网要不太平了
item.description: 36Kr: AI reportedly uncovered a high-severity vulnerability hidden for over a decade, raising concern about AI-driven exploitation.

item.title: 一个PHP漏洞公开45分钟后，攻击量暴涨百倍的黑色十月
item.description: 至顶网: Attacks surged about 100-fold within 45 minutes of a PHP flaw's disclosure, in a wave already tracked as AI-driven mass exploitation.

item.title: Moonshot Reduce Las Capacidades De Ciberataque De Kimi K3.1
item.description: www.elperiodico.digital: Moonshot reportedly reduces the cyberattack capabilities of its Kimi K3.1 model.

item.title: StealthRL: Reinforcement Learning Paraphrase Attacks for Multi-Detector Evasion of AI-Text Detectors
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents StealthRL, a reinforcement-learning paraphrase attack that evades AI-text detectors.

item.title: From Review to Authorization: Key-Isolated Threshold Signing for LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes key-isolated threshold signing so mistaken LLM agent judgments cannot reach execution unchecked.

item.title: Honeyquest for LLMs: Rethinking Cyber Deception for AI Attackers
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper introduces Honeyquest for LLMs, evaluating cyber deception against autonomous AI attackers.

item.title: LocalAlign: Enabling Generalizable Prompt Injection Defense via Generation of Near-Target Adversarial Examples for Alignment Training
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents LocalAlign, which uses near-target adversarial examples for alignment training against prompt injection.

item.title: WebAgentGuard: A Reasoning-Driven Guard Model for Detecting Prompt Injection Attacks in Web Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents WebAgentGuard, a guard model that detects prompt injection against web agents.

item.title: On Task, Off Track: Benchmarking LLM and Agent Robustness to Near-Target Prompt Injection
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper benchmarks LLM and agent robustness to near-target prompt injection that stays close to the user's task.

item.title: TRACE: Data-Free Text Reconstruction Attacks against Approximate Unlearning in LLMs
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents TRACE, a data-free attack that reconstructs text removed by approximate LLM unlearning.

item.title: Agentic AI Defense: Decode-Time Provenance Binding for MCP
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows cross-modal prompt injection via an email-signature image against MCP agents and proposes a defense.

item.title: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents Ulysses, a harness for AI agents to synthesize verifiable web exploits.

item.title: Omni-UBench: Benchmarking Omni-Modal LLM-based Guardrails Across Safety, Utility, and Reliability
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper benchmarks safety, utility and reliability of guardrails for omni-modal LLMs facing a wider attack surface.

item.title: AI Hackers Arrested for Stealing 8.2 Million Corporate Records
item.description: 조선일보: Korean police arrested a group that used generative AI to hack companies and steal about 8.2 million records.

item.title: 非信息技术专业人士利用生成式人工智能黑入企业，窃取820万条个人信息索财- 阿视亚经济
item.description: 아시아경제: Non-IT suspects reportedly used generative AI to breach companies and steal 8.2 million personal records for extortion.

item.title: Т-Банк: 78 исследователей за 3 мес. выявили ИИ-атаки без критич. ущерба
item.description: Techora.ru: T-Bank says 78 researchers over three months identified AI-driven attacks that caused no critical damage.

item.title: 不专攻信息技术(IT)领域,通过博客等学习人工智能(AI)黑客方法,窃取800万件以上个人信息的一伙人被警方逮捕。 这是国内首例恶意利用生成型AI的大规模黑客及窃取个人信息犯罪相关的嫌疑人检举事例。
item.description: 매일경제: South Korean police arrested a group who learned AI hacking from blogs and stole 8M+ personal records, reportedly the first such generative-AI case.

item.title: دعوى قضائية ضد OpenAI بعد انتحار فتى لبناني بسب "ChatGPT"
item.description: سكاي نيوز عربية: Lawsuit against OpenAI follows the suicide of a Lebanese teenager allegedly linked to ChatGPT, per Sky News Arabia.
